title: Mustard pork with cabbage and apple
summary: Mustard pork with cabbage and apple is a british dinner built around pork fillet and white cabbage, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat pork fillet dry and season it. Prep white cabbage and eating apples for Mustard pork with cabbage and apple so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook pork fillet on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook white cabbage and eating apples in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Mustard pork with cabbage and apple before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice pork fillet and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
